title: Lester leaves Bronson for Albuquerque and returns in 1930
summary: Lester stayed until January 1930, went to his father in Albuquerque where Ben Webster played piano, and came back to Bronson in May or June 1930.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: How long was Lester in there? He joined in January 1928, and how long did he stay in the first time?

Mmm, he stayed in until about '30 -- January of '30. He went back out in Albuquerque, New Mexico, where his Daddy was. That's when Ben Webster was with him. When Les went out there, Ben was there, playing piano.
What brought Ben out there to Albuquerque?
Ben was playing with his father. He always kept a show or a band or something going.
I see. You were saying that after Lester Young left the family band, then Ben Webster got in.
Well, Ben wasn't playing sax so much. He was playing piano. Learning saxophone.
You're saying Ben Webster was playing in Willis Young's band, playing piano.
Yeah. And then, after that, Les came back to Bronson -- he came back to Bronson in 1930.
Must have been May. The latter part of May or the first of June.
